Step 1: The subject is "my neighbour" (he or she), so the verb needs -s: walks.
Step 2: "always" goes before the main verb.
Result: "My neighbour always walks in the park."

Put "never" in the right place: "Anna ___ ___ (drive) to work."
Write the whole sentence.
